name: GO-SHIP and historical repeat hydrography / GLODAPv2.2022
model_or_instrument: Ship-based hydrographic cruises (WOCE, JGOFS, CLIVAR, GO-SHIP)
access: Data were collected and made publicly available by the International Global Ship-based Hydrographic Investigations Program (GO-SHIP) (Sloyan et al., 2019) and the national programs that contribute to it.

scales.note: GLODAPv2.2022 and GO-SHIP hydrographic station profiles spanning 1972-2021 with typical station spacing of ~20 km.
